name: Instrumentation
description: Per-turn end-to-end latency tracing: a turn id born at message_received threads through every lifecycle hook, and one summary line per turn names where the time went.
author: Eddie's stack

summaryLine.description: Emit one console summary line per completed turn (default true).

slowTurnWarnMs.description: Also WARN when a turn's end-to-end time exceeds this (default 10000).
